## Row type

A row returned from a [Connection.select()](./database.connection.select.md)<!-- -->, keyed by column name.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type Row = Record<string, unknown>;
```

## Remarks

Values are `unknown` because each driver maps SQL types differently — a Postgres `boolean` arrives as a JavaScript boolean, while the sqlite drivers hand back `0` or `1`<!-- -->. Pass a type argument to `select` to assert the shape you expect.
